simple: Protection for Android and iOS smartphones and tablets against mobile threats (Mobile Threat Defense). Blocks downloads of malicious apps — analyzing them in the cloud with machine learning, sandboxing and code analysis — and malicious files before they reach device storage. Blocks phishing, including new phishing sites, in all apps (Zero-Phishing), malicious sites and unwanted categories in any browser and communication of infected devices with command servers (Anti-Bot), controls DNS, detects man-in-the-middle attacks and malicious Wi-Fi and disconnects from them. Finds vulnerable OS versions, rooting and jailbreaking and keeps risky devices away from corporate data regardless of MDM. Deploys through your existing MDM/UEM without user interaction, works with work and personal profiles and does not analyze personal data.
